title: 28-Layer Expanded Chirped Stack with Increased Design Degrees of Freedom
scientific_hypothesis: Increasing layer count from 24 to 28 within the 30-layer manufacturing constraint provides additional degrees of freedom for the optimizer to simultaneously satisfy the dual-band objectives (high transmittance at 1530-1565nm, high reflectance at 400-700nm), potentially recovering or exceeding the round-1 best score of 0.9482.
design_principle: Linear quarter-wave chirp initialization spanning 450-650nm center wavelengths across the stack, with all 28 layer thicknesses as independent optimization variables. Alternating HfO2/SiO2 sequence starting with HfO2 on substrate side.
proposed_topology: exactly 6 alternating HfO2/SiO2 pairs (12 finite layers)
design_variables: Initial thickness values from linear chirp profile
theory_basis: Quarter-wave dielectric stack principle for high-reflection mirrors
Evolutionary optimization for bounded multilayer variables
expected_advantages: 4 additional layers provide more spectral shaping freedom
Linear chirp initialization proven effective in round-1
Approaches manufacturing limit without exceeding it
known_risks: Increased layer count may complicate fabrication tolerance
Optimizer may struggle with higher-dimensional search space
No guarantee score improvement over 24L baseline
execution_request_english: Design and optimize a 28-layer planar multilayer dielectric film on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Materials: alternating HfO2 and SiO2, starting with HfO2 adjacent to substrate (14 complete pairs, 28 finite layers total). Initialize layer thicknesses using linear quarter-wave chirp with center wavelengths ranging from 450nm to 650nm across the stack. All 28 layer thicknesses are independent optimization variables with bounds [30nm, 120nm]. Optimize for maximum mean transmittance in 1530-1565nm band and maximum mean reflectance in 400-700nm band. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates count, tightest_margin, and final thicknesses_nm array for all candidates. Topology realization override: disregard any symbolic repeat count, range, or ellipsis above and use exactly 6 alternating HfO2/SiO2 pairs (12 finite layers). Optimize only continuous physical thicknesses; the task compiler must fully expand every finite layer. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 1530-1565 nm, 400-700 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band; High reflectance in 400-700 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Low reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band; Low transmittance in 400-700 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Maximum 30 layers.
revision_reason: Increased layer count from 24 to 28 to exploit remaining manufacturing headroom (30-layer max). Changed from previous 24L topology to test whether additional degrees of freedom recover round-1 performance.
